description:
FILES: extensions/git_checkpoint.ex, test/octo_pi/coder/extensions/git_checkpoint_test.exs

REQUIRES: opi-fin.2.2, opi-fin.2.3

GitCheckpoint is stateful with a checkpoints map (%{entry_id => stash_ref}). It also uses API.bind_core for the exec fn-field (shell execution).

MIGRATION:
1. Add 'use OctoPi.Coder.Extension'.
2. Remove def init(api, checkpoints). Macro generates init/1.
3. Add def mount, do: {:ok, %{}} (empty checkpoints map).
4. Convert turn_start, session_before_fork, agent_end handlers to 3-arity callbacks with checkpoints map as state.
5. Handlers return {result, updated_checkpoints}.

IMPORTANT: DO NOT remove API.bind_core usage for exec fn-field. The exec action fn-field migration is Phase 6. The factory in tests still needs to call API.bind_core(api, %{exec: exec_fn}) BEFORE calling GitCheckpoint.init(api). The macro-generated init/1 must be called AFTER bind_core has set exec. Verify this works: factory = fn api -> api = API.bind_core(api, %{exec: exec_fn}); GitCheckpoint.init(api) end.

TEST: git_checkpoint_test.exs -- remove outer Agent.start_link for checkpoints. Keep the exec_fn injection via bind_core. Update factory to the pattern above.
title: Migrate GitCheckpoint to mount/0 pattern
